# Artwork that is not ours

Kept here for provenance. The game does not load these files — the bytes are
embedded in `cursor-race.html` as data URIs, because the same file has to run
both as a claude.ai artifact and on our own domain, and only an embedded copy
works in both.

## kamishs-wrath-busy.webp

- **Creator:** Cursors-4U.com
- **Licence:** [CC BY-NC 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/)
- **Source:** https://www.cursors-4u.com/cursor/kamishs-wrath-solo-leveling-busy
- **Fetched:** 23 October 2026, the 64 preview (96×96, animated, 32 frames, 90,836 bytes)

Two things follow from that licence, and both are load-bearing:

**NonCommercial.** The moment this game carries advertising, sells coins, or takes
money in any other way, this cursor has to come out. The terms screen says the
game takes no money, and that is not only a promise to players — it is the
condition this artwork is used under.

**Cursors-4U licensed their rendering, not the character.** Kamish is from Solo
Leveling, and those rights rest with its creators; a CC licence from a third
party cannot grant them. The risk is small for a free fan cursor and it is not
zero, so if a rights holder ever objects, the answer is to remove it rather than
to argue.

Credit lives in `ART_CREDITS` in `cursor-race.html`, which the terms screen reads
directly, so what players are shown cannot drift from what ships.
